title: Final mean after iterative bribery
statement: Let $f$ be a coordinatewise monotone Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, where $n\ge 2$, and suppose its mean is at least $-99/100$. After the bribery procedure has run for $n$ steps, forcing the coordinates in its resulting set to $+1$ gives a function whose mean is at least $99/100$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
The mean of $f$ is at least $-99/100$
